PROSOCHE Device Probe - spike 001 diagnostic.
Runs Get Device Details four times, once per Detail of interest, then shows all four returned values on a single screen.
- Every Detail used here is verified against Apple's own ToolKit enum catalog, so all four are guaranteed-valid picker options. - Three of the four literals originally proposed for this spike were wrong and have been corrected: "OS Version" is really "System Version", and "Build Number" / "Software Version" are really "System Build Number". - The remaining open question is the FORMAT of the returned values, especially whether Device Model returns a raw identifier or a marketing name. Only a real device can answer that.
Run once on the target iPhone and report the four values exactly as shown.

Shortcuts generated by Shortcuts Playground. May contain mistakes. Always check the shortcut's actions first.
This shortcut was created via the following user prompt:
> Build a minimal iOS Shortcut for a spike experiment (PROSOCHE project): a tiny probe shortcut that calls is.workflow.actions.getdevicedetails four times, once each for the candidate WFDeviceDetail literal values "Device Model", "Device Name", "OS Version" (alternate "System Version") and "Build Number" (alternate "Software Version"), and shows all results on one screen so a human can run it once on a real iPhone and report back what is valid. Record every guess and its rationale so the on-device test either confirms or refutes each one.

--- THE FOUR PROBES ---
- Probe 1 Device Model: the known-good baseline, independently confirmed by decrypted donor evidence from the target iPhone. - Probe 2 Device Name: was a guess, now confirmed as a real picker option. - Probe 3 System Version: replaces the refuted guess "OS Version". - Probe 4 System Build Number: replaces the refuted guesses "Build Number" and "Software Version".
The complete valid option list for this picker is: Device Name, Device Hostname, Device Model, Device Is Watch, System Version, System Build Number, Screen Width, Screen Height, Current Volume, Current Brightness, Current Appearance, Device Is Locked.

--- COMBINED RESULT SCREEN ---
- The result screen below shows all four values at once so the whole spike can be captured in a single screenshot. - Each of the four lines is filled by the matching Get Device Details action above, in the order they appear. - If any line comes back blank, that Detail is a valid option but returns nothing on this hardware; report that as a blank rather than skipping it.

PROSOCHE DEVICE PROBE - RESULTS
1. Device Model ￼
2. Device Name ￼
3. System Version ￼
4. System Build Number ￼
Report all four values back exactly as shown. The key question is the FORMAT of Device Model: a raw identifier such as iPhone16,1 or a marketing name such as iPhone 16 Pro.
